effective_date_basis: earliest possible = end of the month following the quarter
filing_basis: ESTIMATE: 3 quarter(s) scaled to a year (CRA uses actual annual revenue)
notes: small-supplier status ends at the end of the month following the quarter in which the threshold was exceeded
start charging on the first supply after that date; register within 29 days of the effective date
effective date is no later than your first supply after 2026-07-31; shown is the earliest possible, so the true register-by may be later (pass --first-supply YYYY-MM-DD)
filing frequency is an approximation: CRA assigns it from taxable supplies made in Canada in your preceding fiscal year, not the worldwide figure used for the threshold (canada.ca, change-account)

Enter sales before GST/HST (canada.ca does not spell this out: unverified), in Canadian dollars. Not modeled: which supplies are associates' or excluded, voluntary registration, charities; enter already-adjusted figures.
